items.title: Block Fashion
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: Have you ever wanted to blend in, but be fashionable doing it?

items.title: Alien Takeover
items.creator: NovaEGG
items.description: You've come from deep in the galaxy for only one reason, fashion!

items.title: Rainbow Animal Onesies
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Be a colorful purple dinosaur, a green tiger, or a blue fox! Show off your love of color and animals while staying cute and trendy!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Collect all animal onesie skin packs!

items.title: Cyberpunk Skin Pack
items.creator: Kreatik Studios
items.description:
Do you fancy being a cyberpunk or techno punk pro and do you want to go on an adventure in the future? Equip secret agent cop skins or be a robotic hero in your world. Discover any futuristic modern city with flying cars and stand out in abstract, glowing neon colors. Be the cool kid in town!

+ Great for roleplay
+ 10 cyberpunk skins
+2 free skins

By Kreatik Studios

items.title: Anime Friends
items.creator: Norvale
items.description:
Anime friends! Dress up in colorful, fabulous, and last but not least friendly anime skins! Choose between ten cool and unique skins, and go on adventures in style. Suitable for single-player adventures and roleplaying with friends. 

+ 1 free skin
+ A total of 10 cool and unique skins
By Norvale

items.title: Free Form: Space Among US
items.creator: CanadaWebDeveloper
items.description:
Free Form: Space Among US is the perfect skin pack to show off to your friends and have fun being different from others!

33 HD (128px) skins including:

- 2 free!
- 8 space aliens
- 7 characters with bright colors
- 6 space crew members
- 5 engineers
- 5 A.I. robots

2 Exclusive skins by: Dannny0117 and ACPixel

Created and Published by: Dannny0117 + Canada Web Developer.

items.description:
*unintelligible grunts*

*12 cave people
*2 free skins

items.title: Trendsetters
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Don't be a follower, become a leader. Set the scene and start a new trend with these fashionable teens! 

*12 trendy teens
*2 free skins

items.title: Toy Mobs
items.creator: Monster Egg Studios
items.description:
Fresh from the toy box, these mobs are here to play! 

*12 toy mobs
*2 free skins

items.title: City Police
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Serve as the friendliest of officers in City Police skins. Enforce the law with a smile when you role-play walking a beat and lending a hand to your community. Direct traffic in busy intersections or help kids and elderly cross the street. Look out for the safety of all the citizens, because they are counting on you!

+ 8 pleasantly protecting HD skins

items.title: Fruit Parrots
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
They say don’t play with your food. But what if you are food? Have tons of fun role-playing with friends as bird-shaped food in Fruit Parrots skins. Fly high in the sky looking like a watermelon or strawberry with bill, wings, and feathers! Swoop down over the city as potato or pineapple-plumed creatures. Talk it up and repeat everything you hear at school!

+ 8 HD skins

items.title: Techno Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Vibrate to the beat and dance all night when you role-play with friends in Techno Demons skins. Show off your best moves and role-play as misbehaving little devils. Gear up in glow-in-the-dark horns and outfits as you groove to the music. Sure, you might try to play a trick or two on the dance floor, you are a little troublemaker after all!

+ 8 glowing impish HD skins

items.title: Love Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Hopelessly devoted to love? Look magical and magnificent in charming Love Demons skins. Be extra enchanting everywhere you go as you role-play with friends and fly over the city. Flutter your wings and polish your horns as you glide across the sky spreading true love and happiness always and forever. Cupid’s got nothing on you!

+ 8 cute cherub-like HD skins

items.title: Moon Warriors
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Drop down from a heavenly body in the night sky in magnificent Moon Warriors skins. In suitable celestial armor, role-play with friends as defenders of the lunar world. In sparkling pink, bright blue, or glowing green attire, use your swift sword or brisk bow and arrow with super skills. With elegance and honor, protect your colorful clan.

+ 8 noble rising HD skins

items.title: Plant Monsters
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Time to spread fear, Plant Monsters are here! Gear up as frightful flora and role-play with friends as hideous fruits and vegetables. March up and down the city streets in skins sure to scare Minecraft residents. Pumpkins petrify and tomatoes terrify while cucumbers chill anyone right to their bones and sinister strawberries with three eyes spook at school.

+ 8 HD skins

items.title: Swordsmen vs Archers
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Take up a most noble fight in heroic Swordsmen vs Archers skins. Draw your sword or crossbow when you role-play with friends as worthy combatants. Remove your dagger from its sheath and challenge your opponent to a duel. Cover your face with a bandana, pull out your crossbow, and aim arrows to defeat your enemies.

+ 8 lances vs arrows HD skins

items.title: Tiny Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Maybe you’re little, but you’re more than a little mischievous. Get ready to play some big tricks in Tiny Demons skins. Your horns will set you apart when you role-play with friends dressed in cute and colorful fashions. Try to fool whoever you can and have a gigantic good laugh. That rogue spirit in you just has to come out!

+ 8 little devil HD skins

items.title: Dumb Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Fool and fiend, rolled into one! In crazy grins and goofy eyes, role-play with friends in dopey Dumb Demons skins. Gear up as a not too smart creature in super chic horns and fashionable red and black clothing. Try real hard to use your brain as much as you can to stir up some mischief.

+ 8 stupid supernatural creature HD skins

items.title: Cyber Farm
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Dairy, livestock, and exotic species, this Cyber Farm has it all! Role-play with friends in high-tech animal skins down on the farm. Be a cutting-edge cow with bell around your neck or newfangled pig looking for a mud puddle. Buzz around as a futuristic bee and make lots of honey. Manage the farm as a cyber dog or helpful robo horse. This isn’t city life!

+ 8 HD skins

items.title: Noob Blocks
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
Stumble and bumble through city streets in totally nitwit Noob Blocks skins. Gear up in googly eyes and silly smiles and just look goofy when you role-play with friends dressed as your favorite foolish blocks. Be loopy as lava, mad as magma, or crazy as coal. No fool’s gold here, just emeralds, diamond ore, and fools!

+ 8 mindless mineral HD skins

items.title: Hospital Roleplay
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
The perfect place to practice medicine? The local hospital, where you can role-play with friends in doctor and nurse skins. Use all of your medical training as a top-notch surgeon or kind-hearted pediatrician to treat ill and injured patients. Direct the staff as chief physician to make sure this hospital always gives the best care possible!

+ 8 medically minded HD skins

items.title: Ninja Demons
items.creator: GoE-Craft
items.description:
The perfect combination of mischief and mystery! Become a devil of a spy when you role-play with friends in Ninja Demons skins. Prowl in the shadows, complete with horns, mask, and classic Japanese robes. Become a master of stealth and secrecy, planning your attack. What sort of tricks will you play as a naughty undercover demon?

+ 8 secret agent spirit HD skins

items.title: Laboratory Escape
items.creator: UUUM
items.description:
Escape from this dangerous research facility! Clear a number of challenges using parkour. Find out what lies beyond the darkness of this mysterious place. 

- Stages full of gimmicks. 
- Escape with your trustworthy NPC 
- 12 HD skin packs

items.title: Spring Teens
items.creator: Pathway Studios
items.description: Not quite sure what to wear this Spring? Still deciding what's next? Let this new spring teen pack inspire you with a variety of cute, colorful, modern styles. These 8 fashionable skins are sure to get you out of that winter rut and leaping into this new season with lifted spirits and creativity!
